_comment: Approved permissions and exported components of the release merged manifest. Add an entry only with the task or store-checklist row that justifies it (docs/store/READINESS.md). ${applicationId} stands for the application id.

uses-permission.android.permission.INTERNET: Mail sync: the Rust core opens its own TLS connections to the person's IMAP and SMTP servers (docs/store/READINESS.md, permissions table; T16).
uses-permission.android.permission.ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE: The connectivity callback (ConnectivityManager.registerDefaultNetworkCallback) that tells the core whether the device has a network, so that the Offline banner is true and nothing is sent while offline (T16). Normal permission, no data leaves the device.
uses-permission.${applicationId}.DYNAMIC_RECEIVER_NOT_EX: AndroidX core adds this signature-level permission (declared by the app itself, protectionLevel signature) so that dynamically registered receivers are not exported; not grantable to other apps.

permission.${applicationId}.DYNAMIC_RECEIVER_NOT_EX: The declaration paired with the uses-permission above; must stay protectionLevel=signature.

receiver:androidx.profileinstaller.Profi.why: AndroidX profileinstaller (baseline profiles): lets the shell trigger profile installation. Only the system or adb can hold android.permission.DUMP, so other apps cannot call it.
